network.optional_method: doc2vec/embedding sensitivity only; must not replace frozen baseline after results

transaction_cost_implementation.interpretation: all-in execution drag applied independently to each buy and sell side

fundamentals.source: SEC Financial Statement Data Sets / XBRL as filed
fundamentals.formation_rule: latest eligible filing with information_date <= formation_date
fundamentals.quantconnect_role: historical tradable universe, point-in-time CIK mapping, market prices/returns, and contemporaneous market cap only; accounting factor values come from SEC

factor_definitions.demand_accel: legacy frozen field name; SEC as-filed revenue_growth_yoy for the latest filing available at formation
factor_definitions.pricing_power: SEC gross_margin_change_yoy; fall back to operating_margin_change_yoy when gross-margin change is unavailable
factor_definitions.quality: SEC fcf_margin minus SEC leverage; fall back to operating_margin minus leverage when FCF margin is unavailable
factor_definitions.competitive_scarcity: SEC Item 1 TF-IDF text_scarcity_raw from latest network snapshot available at formation
factor_definitions.valuation: negative log(1 + contemporaneous QuantConnect market_cap / annualized SEC as-filed revenue); qtrs=4 revenue used directly, qtrs=1 revenue multiplied by 4; other flow-period lengths are rejected
factor_definitions.high52: current adjusted price divided by maximum adjusted price over the latest 252 trading observations

cost_model.bid_ask: LatestPriceFillModel on Market-On-Open orders: next QuoteBar ask open for buys and bid open for sells

leaps.execution_timing: select from completed daily chain; submit equity-option Market-On-Open order for the next regular session
leaps.roll_execution: when a roll is due, sell the existing LEAPS at the next regular-session open; select the replacement from that day's completed chain; buy the replacement at the following regular-session open

pre_result_corrections: 2026-09-23: removed undocumented utilities/financials SIC exclusions from QuantConnect Bottleneck universe; frozen universe has no sector exclusion.
2026-09-23: specified 15 bps one-way equity transaction cost as all-in ConstantSlippageModel execution drag per buy/sell side with zero separate commission for the Bottleneck tournament.
2026-09-23: specified quarterly formation as the first trading day of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct in the daily QuantConnect implementation.
2026-09-23: required per-rebalance selected-name/signal audit export to Object Store.

2026-09-23: LEAPS security initialization changed from replacement to additive initialization so IBKR brokerage fee/buying-power/settlement defaults are preserved while 0/5/10 bps option slippage is layered on top; selection and actual fill audits are persisted.

2026-09-23: switched Bottleneck accounting factor values from QuantConnect/Morningstar financial statements to the SEC as-filed formation-date panel; QuantConnect remains the historical tradable-universe/CIK/market-return engine. This implements the intended SEC -> QuantConnect free-PIT architecture before any return results were observed.
2026-09-23: removed the early-sample 200-day substitute for the 12-month momentum/52-week-high signals; both now require 252 trading observations before a name can be scored.

2026-09-23: Item 1 extraction now preserves only Item 1/1A/1B/2 boundary rows found inside HTML tables and discards other table text, addressing modern inline-XBRL section headings without contaminating the TF-IDF corpus.

2026-09-23: changed LEAPS execution from same-daily-slice market orders to next-session Market-On-Open orders. Contract selection occurs only after the daily chain is known; execution uses the next session's quote-side open plus frozen slippage. Contract/entry-date state is now set only on confirmed fills.
2026-09-23: SEC flow facts are now strict on period length: 10-K/20-F/40-F require qtrs=4 and 10-Q requires qtrs=1. YTD values are not silently substituted for single-quarter flows.

2026-09-23: valuation now annualizes qtrs=1 SEC revenue by 4 before comparing it with contemporaneous market cap; qtrs=4 annual revenue is used directly. This removes the prior 10-K/10-Q scale mismatch.

2026-09-23: Bottleneck price history now records every daily fundamental-universe observation before applying today's eligibility screen, and a 252-daily-bar warm-up primes the 2009 start. Momentum no longer measures 252 'eligible days' when liquidity eligibility is intermittent.

2026-09-23: LEAPS rolls are now sequenced rather than submitting the exit and replacement entry to the same opening auction. The old contract exits next open, the replacement is selected from that day's completed chain, and the new contract enters the following open. This introduces a conservative one-session gap and removes ambiguous buying-power/order sequencing at 100% premium allocation.
